objective: Ensure provider-facing gold labels are derivable from authorized source semantics rather than opaque fixture-local identifiers that a source-only extractor cannot infer.

finding.problem: The original SYNTHETIC-STRESS-GOLD-v1 corpus is valid for scorer and safety-harness qualification but contains opaque synthetic identifiers such as A11, EV6, C1, and Q1. Those identifiers are not available in ExtractionRequest and therefore cannot be fairly recovered by a source-only candidate provider.
finding.disposition: Retain the original corpus unchanged as a scorer/failure-detection harness. Use a separate provider-facing source-held-out corpus whose labels have deterministic semantic forms derivable from the source text and task contract.

provider_facing_label_rules: Labels must describe an observation, relation, status, or function that is semantically recoverable from the authorized source text.
A provider must not require case_id, hidden gold, corpus row order, or fixture-local opaque IDs to form a prediction label.
Entity names may appear when explicitly present in the source.
Lexical anchor identifiers may be normalized from an explicit source phrase using lowercase underscore normalization.
Ambiguous evidence must use ALTERNATIVE, UNRESOLVED, or ABSTAIN rather than ASSERTED merely to improve recall.
A provider may return no semantic claim for a task and instead emit an ABSTAIN prediction.
Candidate outputs remain observations only and never authorize canonical-state materialization.
non_goals: Changing the established canonical narrative-state identifiers
Rewriting the original scorer qualification corpus
Granting this label surface canonical authority
Encoding author intent or publication decisions into extraction labels
promotion_requirement: A future learned/model provider must be evaluated on a frozen source-held-out corpus using the same provider-facing semantic label contract or a versioned successor with an explicit migration receipt.
